passive.name: Punishment
passive.text: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **0.6/0.75/0.9/1.05/1.2**/s. Attacks from the equipper increase all units' DMG against a struck target by **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%** for 3 seconds. During this period, this effect is further increased by **1.7/2/2.5/3/3.3%** every 0.5s, up to a maximum additional increase of **10.2/12/15/18/19.8%**. Repeated triggers only refresh the duration without refreshing the DMG increase effect. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

passive.name: Stampede Accident
passive.text: When any friendly unit in the squad attacks and hits an enemy, all friendly units' ATK increases by **2.5/2.8/3.2/3.6/4%** for 8s, stacking up to 4 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately, and each friendly unit can provide 1 stack of the buff. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

substatLine: Anomaly Proficiency = CRIT Rate = ATK% > CRIT DMG > PEN > FLAT ATK
skillPriority: Chain Attack > Special Attack > Basic Attack > Assist > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Whack the Dimwit
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to attack up to 4 times, dealing **Physical DMG** and **Electric DMG**.
Performing other actions with Rina during Drusilla and Anastella's attacks will not interrupt Rina's **Basic Attack** combo count.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool
entries.text:
Hold Basic Attack or Special Attack to activate:
Calls back Drusilla and Anastella to swing them around for a ranged attack, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge: Dress Adjustment
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Sudden Surprise
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to execute a piercing attack, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Bangboo Callback
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Duple Meter Allemande
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Evasive Assist: Triple Meter Courante
entries.text:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates **Vital View**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Quadruple Meter Gavotte
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after an **Evasive Assist** to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to continuously advance while generating a vortex of electricity, dealing **Electric DMG**.
While using this skill, Rina can quickly chain into **EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Beat the Blockhead
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Order Anastella to execute a downward smash, dealing **Electric DMG**
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to unleash a continuous downward smash attack, dealing massive **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a **Quick Assist** is triggered.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Code of Conduct
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to push forward and generate a ball-shaped electrical field that deals massive **Electric DMG**.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to perform **Basic Attacks**, **Dash Attacks**, **Special Attacks**, and **EX Special Attacks**, but can be recalled to Rina's side through **Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A **Quick Assist** is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

entries.name: Ultimate: The Queen's Attendants
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward, dealing massive **Electric DMG**.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to respond to **Basic Attack**, **Dash Attack**, **Special Attack**, or **EX Special Attack** commands, but can be recalled to Rina's side through **Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool**.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in recovers an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a **Quick Assist** is triggered.

entries.name: Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner
entries.text: When ordering Drusilla or Anastella to attack, other squad members' PEN Ratio increases together with Rina's, by 25% of Rina's PEN Ratio + **12%**, up to 30%. The effect ends when both Drusilla and Anastella return to Rina.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Banquet of Perfection
entries.text:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
Increases the duration of **Shock** inflicted on enemies by any character by 3s. When **Shocked** enemies are on the field, all squad members' **Electric DMG** increases by 10%.

entries.name: Dance Duet
entries.text:
After being sent out to launch an attack, Drusilla and Anastella stay in place for an additional 5.5s before returning to Rina.
The buff gained from **Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner** by characters within 10m is increased to 130%.

entries.name: Master's Paragon
entries.text: Upon becoming the active character in combat, Rina's DMG increases by 15% for 12s. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

entries.name: Head Maid's Specialty
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Needle and Hammer
entries.text:
Rina's Energy Regen increases by 0.5/s when both Drusilla and Anastella are deployed.
The effect ends when Drusilla or Anastella returns to Rina.

entries.name: Head Maid Perfectionist
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Stormy Night's Fright
entries.text: When an **EX Special Attack**, **Chain Attack** or **Ultimate** hits an enemy, the entire squad's **Electric DMG** is increased by 15% for 8s.
